description:
The transactions page currently fetches and renders every transaction matching the filters, with no limit or pagination. Each row is a stateful HTMX form, so 2000+ rows will start to feel sluggish. Default the view to the current month and let users navigate to other months (same pattern as the dashboard), with a "Show all" escape hatch when needed.

Scope:
1. Router: accept year, month, show_all query params; default to current month if unset
2. Apply posted_at range filter when not show_all
3. Compute prev_year/prev_month/next_year/next_month for navigation
4. Template: month nav strip (Prev / month label / Next / Today) and a "Show all" button
5. Preserve existing account_id, category_id, uncategorized_only filters
6. Tests
title: Default /transactions to current month with navigation
